steps.title: Three partners, one course.
steps.text: We invest alongside management teams and our investors. In Customized Distribution Services (CDS), that meant a partnership between the company's management team, LongueVue Capital and Lake Ten.

steps.title: A plan built on its legacy.
steps.text: CDS manages 2 million square feet of food-grade warehouse space in New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Georgia, Missouri and California. Its senior leadership stays in place, and the plan values its 30-year legacy of people, culture and customers.

steps.title: Resources for the next chapter.
steps.text: Lake Ten and LongueVue bring strategic and financial resources to expand CDS's geographic reach and services into new markets.

portfolioIntro: In October 2026, Lake Ten made its inaugural platform investment, partnering with the management team of Customized Distribution Services and LongueVue Capital.

team.name: Paul Psak
team.title: Founder & Managing Partner
team.sum: Paul founded Lake Ten in 2022 and leads the firm's investment activity.
bio: Paul founded Lake Ten Capital Partners in 2022 and leads the firm's investment activity, working alongside Lake Ten's operating partners, and the management teams and institutional partners it invests with.

Before founding Lake Ten, Paul was Managing Director and Chief Financial Officer of Ferro Holdings and Vatera Capital Management. He previously served as a Senior Analyst at Vatera Holdings and as an Assistant Vice President at Brown Brothers Harriman, where he worked in alternative asset allocation and risk management roles. Paul began his career at PricewaterhouseCoopers in New York.
Paul is a graduate of King's College, where he serves on the Board of Directors, and is a Certified Public Accountant licensed in New York. He lives in West Palm Beach with his wife and two sons.
